newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan, Nepal agree to expand trade ties.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan, Nepal agree to expand trade ties.

text.p: The prime ministers of Nepal and Pakistan agreed on Saturday to strengthen trade and economic ties, the official news agency APP reported.

Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto and her visiting Nepalese counterpart Sher Bhadur Deuba also discussed regional and international issues, including the situation in the disputed territory of Kashmir, the agency said. It gave no details.

Pakistan and Nepal also signed agreements to set up a joint business council and to hold consultations between their foreign ministries. They decided that their finance ministers should attend a joint economic commission due to meet early next year.
